column.name: filters
column.description: JSON-encoded active facet/query state at submission time (e.g. category, brand, price range). Read from the submitted POST body, not independently re-verified against a live search — see search_feedback.transfer.xml's SearchFeedbackTicketRequest comment for the full trust-boundary note. Not interpreted as markup anywhere it is displayed.

column.name: sku_list
column.description: JSON-encoded array of product SKUs actually rendered on the page the ticket was filed against.

column.name: customer_reference
column.description: Deliberately not a real FK to spy_customer — loose coupling across the Client/Zed boundary, same convention spy_search_ranking_query_rating.customer_reference uses in search-ranking-optimizer.

column.name: author_type
column.description: SearchFeedbackConfig::AUTHOR_TYPE_* — determines which of the two identity columns below is set.

column.name: fk_user
column.description: Set only when author_type=zed_user — the replying Zed admin.

column.name: customer_reference
column.description: Set only when author_type=customer — same loose-coupling convention as the parent ticket's own customer_reference, not a real FK.

column.name: raw_response
column.description: JSON-encoded raw Elasticsearch response body for the search the ticket was filed against — captured server-side by this package's own capture plugins (see SearchFeedbackSnapshotResultFormatterPlugin), never client-supplied. Reconstructed into an Elastica\Response at replay time, never inspected field-by-field by this package. CLOB (LONGTEXT), not LONGVARCHAR (plain TEXT, 64KB cap in MySQL) — a real ES response for a full page of products routinely exceeds that.

column.name: query_dsl
column.description: JSON-encoded, fully-expanded Elastica query DSL for the same request (post query-expansion, e.g. after search-ranking's function_score wrapping) — informational only, not replayed against a live search. See SearchFeedbackSnapshotQueryExpanderPlugin.

column.name: request_parameters
column.description: JSON-encoded request-parameters array some result formatters need alongside the raw response (e.g. search-debug's overlay). Optional — not every capture has one.

column.name: has_term_vector_snapshot
column.description: Set once at capture time from whatever search-ranking's optional TermVectorSnapshotProviderPluginInterface implementation actually returned that request. Never re-derived from live config — a ticket filed while specificity weighting was on keeps showing its termvector data even if the flag is later turned off, and vice versa a ticket filed while it was off never gets one backfilled.

column.name: term_vector_snapshot
column.description: JSON-encoded SearchRankingSpecificityWeightingResultTransfer (relevanceWeight, normalizedSpecificity, shift, etc) — NOT a raw _termvectors response, which search-ranking never retains past the request that fetched it. Present only when has_term_vector_snapshot is true.
